description: I Sodomu ahaba Loti haratewe mbere na Loti atwarwa ari inyagano. Aburahamu avyumvise ahitana abantubiwe 300 baja gukurikira ba bansi babahambiriza I Dani . Banesha ba bansi bagaruza n’ivyo bari banyaze vyose. Atahutse asanganirwa na Kedolawoma umwami w’I Sodomu na Melekisedeki umuherezi w’Imana. Aburahamu yanka ubutunzi umwami w’I Sodomu yagira amuhe.
name: Aburahamu abohoza Loti

description: Aburahamu ahungira muri Egiputa. Abwira Abanyeiputa yuko Sarayi ari mushikiwe, Farawo na we aramutwara amumarana igihe kitari gito amugize umugore. Ariko yaratevye aragaruka I Kanani asubia kugirana ubucuti bwiza n’Imana. Mbere yahavuyeatandukana na Loti
name: Aburahamu abwira Sarayi ngo urabwira Abanyegiputa ko uri mushikanje

description: Aburahamu atuma umubwiriza wiwe ngo aje gusabira Isaka umugeni. Labani aca amugabira umukobwa wiwe Rebeka aramujana. Imbere yo gupfa Aburahamu araga ivyiwe Isaka, agabira n’abandi bana bose yavyaye kuri Ketura abatandukanya na Isaka.
name: Aburahamu asabira Isaka umugeni

description: Kubera inzara yari yabaye ndanse I Kanani Aburahamu arahunga aja muri Egiputa. …
name: Aburahamu asuhukira muri Egiputa

description: Kubera ugutirigana kw’ukwizera kwa Aburahamu, Umugore wiwe Sarayi abonye ashaje atavyaye abwira Aburahamu ati enda ni wegere incoreke yacu Hagari umuvyareko umwana. Aburahamu abigira uko nyene . Hagari asama inda ya aburahamu avyara Ishimaeli.
name: Aburahamu avyara ku ncoreke Hagari

description: Aburahamu abona abagabo batatu arabasanganira n’urukundo rwinshi kandi arabazimana. Yasanze yakiriye abamarayika. Basiga bamusezeraniye kuzoronka umwana w’unmuhungu. Imana imumenyesha ko igiye kurandura Sodomu kubera ivyaha vyabo. Aburahamu arabaririra kuko harimwo Loti umuhungwabo. Kandi Imana yarakuyeyo Loti n’abiwe.
name: Aburahamu azimana abamarayika

description: Yakobo abandanya kubwira abana biwe ibizobabako muri kazoza ahereye ku bana ba Yosefu, n’abandi bose ataribwabarire. Aca asaba ko ni yapfa bomuhamba I Kanani mw’itongo rya ba sekuru. Ahejeje kuvuga ivyo arikwega asubiza amaguru ku buriri aca aracikana. Yosefu aja guhamba se I Kanani. Aragaruka aremesha bene se, na bo bongera gusaba imbabazi ku bibi bamukoreye. Ararira aravuga ati reka gutinya
name: Amajambo ya nyuma ya Yakobo n’urupfu rwiwe

description: Bashitse muri Egiputa Yosefu arabakira abaha ivyo kurya abategeka yuko batogaruka batagarukanye na Benyamini. Ikigoyi kibandanije basubira kuja muri Egiputa bajanye na Benyamini. Yosefu abakirira I muhira I we ngo bayage. Baranezerwa baramwunamira.Basangira na we.
name: Bene se ba Yosefu baja gusuma muri Egiputa

description: Bene Yakobo babwira ab’I Shekemu ngo bakebwe kugirango bashobore kurongora umukobwa wabo. Shekemu na se wiwe baca basaba abagabo bose bo mu gisagara ngo bakebwe. Lewi na Simeyoni bahengera ab’I Shekemubamaze imisi itatu bakembwe, bahitana inkota zabo batera igisagara bica abagabo bose, bica Shekemu na se bahitana mushiki wabo Dina barigira.
name: Bene Yakobo bahenda ab’I Shekemu ngo bakebwe.

description: Dina umukobwa wa Leya na Yakobo aja kuramutsa abandi bakobwa . Shekemu mwene Hamor aramubona aramufata ku nguvu. Hanyuma aca asaba ko bomumuha ngo amutware. Basaza ba Dina barababara cane. Baca bategura ingene borwana nyabuna.
name: Dina aja gutembera agafatwa ku nguvu

description: Farawo na we arota abona mu ruzi havuye inka ndwi zivyibushe, haza izindi nwdi mbi cane z’umwaku zirya zimwe nziza. Yongera abona imihurumhumbi ndwi myiza y’ingano, haza iyindi mihuruhumbi ndwi iyongobeza imwe myiza. Abanyabwenge bo muri Egiputa bananirwa kuzisobanura. Farawo atumako Yozefu, ngo amubaze ko yozisobanura, maze Yozefu aca arazisobanura. Farawo amenyeshwa yuko hazoba imyaka 7 y’agahimbo n’indya nyinshi, ariko hagakurikira imyaka 7 y’ikigoyi.
name: Farawo aha Yosefu ubukuru muri Egiputa

description: Abantu bashishikaye gukora ivy’ubuhinga kandi babikoresha ivyaha. Abantu batanguye kwambaza Uhoraho ku ruvyaro rwa Seti na Enoshi. Adamu apfa amaze imyaka 930 amaze kuvyara abahungu n’abakobwa
name: Henoke umuntu adasanzwe yagendaye n’Imana inyaka 300.

description: Imana yaremye abantu ibaha ibibatunga, ivyo yaremye vyose ibona ko ari vyiza.
name: Ico Imana itegetse cose caca kiba uko nyene

description: Imana yiyeretse Aburahamu imutegeka kuva mu gihugu ca Uri  akaja mu gihugu ca Kanani, na we aravyemera. Imana yamusezeraniye kumurondora no kumugira ubwoko bukomeye, abe rurangirannwa kandi ati n’imiryango yose yo mw’isi izogira umugisha kubera wewe.
name: Ihamagarwa rya Aburahamu

description: Nowa abaza ubwato nk’uko Imana imubwiye, yinjiramwo n’abiwe, hamwe n’ibikoko vy’uburyo bwinshi. Bamaze kwinjira mu bwato, bamwe yari yarabwiye ubutumwa bakanka baraza ngo twugururire. Ariko igihe cari carenze.
name: Imana ibwira Nowa ngo aje mu bwato arokoke.

description: Umwuzure uheze, Nowa amaze ghereza ibimazi Imana igirana na we isezerano. Iti genda murondoke, kandi iti sinzosubira kurandurisha isi umwuzure
name: Imana igirana isezerano n’abantu

description: Kubw’akameremere k’icaha kari katanguye kwinjira mu ruvyaro rwa Adamu. Kayini yica mwene nyina kandi yari yaburiwe ngo ntakore icaha, ariko araneshwa. Amaze gukora icaha Imana iramuvuma aja kuyerera.Aregenda ararondoka yubaka n’ibisagara.
name: Imana iha Kayini akaryo ko kwigarura bikamunanira

description: Isaka ageze aho yagiye kuba Gerari, ivyo yarima yimbura incuro ijana, kuko Imana yari kumwe na we. Arateba aba umutunzi bihebuje. Abafilisitiya bamugirira ishari bati tuvemwo kuko uraturuta. Batangura kumusibiriza amariba, ariko haba iriba rimwe batatonganiye na bo aca aryita Rehoboti ati kuko tuzogasara mu gihugu. Ageze I Beri Sheba Imana iramwiyereka iramuhumuriza iti nzokugwiza nzoguha umugisha.
name: Imana ikomeza kubana na Isaka

description: Loti yakira abashitsi, abantu b’I Sodomu bakikiza inzu ya Loti ngo bagomba kwonona ba bashitsi. Loti arwanirira ba bashitsi, hanyuma bakura Loti n’umugore wiwe, n’abakobwa biwe babiri I Sodomu kugira ngo Uhoraho aharandure. Bageze mu nzira Muka Loti araba inyuma yari yabibujijwe, aca ahinduka inkngi y’umunyu
name: Imana irandura Sodomu

description: Imana imanze kurema ijuru n’isi n’ibirimwo vyose, ibona ko ari vyiza, ica irema umuntu mw’ishusho yayo. Yamuhaye ubwenge bwo kwiyumvira kugira ngo aganze ibiri mw’isi kandi ashishikare kurondera Imana no kugira umutima utanduye.
name: Imana irema umuntu mw’ishusho yayo

description: Imana kugira ngo igeze ukwizera kwa Aburahamu imubwira guhereza umwana wiwe kw’ikimazi. Arategura ibikwiye vyose ngo abikore ariko ku muonra wa nyuma Imana iramubuza, mbere aca abona intama iba ari yo atangako ikimazi. Imana ibona ukwizera kwa Aburahamu ibimuharurako nk’ukugororoka
name: Imana isaba Aburahamu kuyiha ishikanwa

description: Imana isezeranira Aburahamu kumuha uruvyaro runini. Yongera kumusezeranira kumuha ighugu c’I Kanani. Imana ntiyemeye ko bahera inyuma y’igihugu c’isezerano n’aho habaye ibihe bitatu vyo gukurwa mu gihugu. Imana ishinga ugukebwa ngo kibe ikimenyetso c’isezerano. Ariko ugukebwa gukuru Imana itugombako ni uguheba icaha.
name: Imana isezeranira Aburahamu ko azovyara umwana w’Isezerano

description: Abanyabwenge bensh ntibahuza ku nkomoko y’ivyo tubona, bisaba kwizera ico ijambo ry’Imana rivuga
name: Imana yamyeho, ni yo yaremye ijuru n’isi

description: Adamu abwira Imana ati nakoze icaha none nakwumvise ncandinyegeza. Na yo ica yica igikoko ironkera umuntu ivyambarwa vyo gupfuka ubwambure bwiwe. Ariko Imana imukura muri Edeni ngo aje kurima isi. Mbere n’imyaka yiwe igagerurwa.
name: Imana yica igikoko ngo umuntu aronke incungu

description: Uhoraho yereka Aburahamu igihugu yagomba kumuha. Bitwibutsa igihugu co mw’ijuru twasezeraniwe n’Imana. Yaciye agerera iHeburoni aho Imana imweretse aca ahashinga amahema aca ahubaka ibicaniro vyo guhrererezako Imana ibimazi
name: Imana yongera gusezerana na Aburahamu

description: Imana yarerekanye imbibe z’igihugu izoha Aburahamu. Na we aca aravyakira n’umutima wizera. Kandi uko Aburahamu yizeye Imana ibimuharurako nk’ukugororoka
name: Imana yongera gusezeranira Aburahamu ko izomuha igihugu

description: Kubera ko Aburahamu atimanye umwana wiwe. Imana yongera kumusezeranira ko izomuha uruvyaro runini. Iti ko wumviye ijwi ryanje nzoguhezagira kandi muri wewe ni ho amahanga yose azoherwa umugisha. Uyu musi ubutumwa bwa Yesu Kristo ari bwo mugisha mukuru bumaze kwamamazwa mu mahanga yose. Mu nyuma Sara arapfa abaheti bamuha isenga ryo guhambamwo umuntu wiwe.
name: Imana yongera gusezeranira Aburahamu umugisha

description: Imana imaze kurema vyose mu misi itandatu iruhuka umusi w;indwi iwita isabato. Imana ibonye ko umugabo akwiye umufasha imuronderera umugore Eva.
name: Imana, iruhuka ku musi w’isabato

description: Yozefu yarose abone imiganda ya bakuruwe yose yunamira umuganda wiwe, arabivuga, baca batahura ko azohava abaganza bakamwunamira. Batangura kumwanka. Ni jo umusi umwe bamugurisha n’Abishimayeli baja kumugurisha muri Egiputa.
name: Indoto za Yozefu zatumye bakuruwe batangura kumwanka

description: Adamu na Eva bahavuye bamenya ko bari gusa bibatera ingorane. Aho kwihutira kwihana baerageje gutwikira icahacabo bakoresheje ibibabi. Imana yongera kumugendera iramubaza iti uri hehe?
name: Ingaruka y’icaha

description: Umwuzure wamaze imisi 40 Nowa atuma inuma ngo amenye iyo amazi ageze. Amazi amaze guhera Nowa n’abiwe n’ivyari mu bwato birasohoka biva mu bwato. Nowa yubaka igicaniro co guhererezako ibimazi vyo kwoswa. Injira muri Yesu urakira.
name: Ingene umwuzure waheze

description: Igitabo c’Itanguriro kivugwamwo ivy’iremwa, ivya Aburahamu n’ukwizera kwiwe, ivya Yosefu uko yaciye mu mageragezwa akomeye akihangana agaheza n’umunezero.
name: Itanguriro, igitabo ngenderwako muri Bibiliya

description: Aburahamu aronka umwana amaze imyaka 100, amwita Isaka. Sara abarira Aburahamu ati irukana Hagari n’umwana wiwe Ishimayeli. N’aho Ishimayeli atari umwana w’isezerano, Imana yamusezeraniye kuzomuhindura ihanga rikomeye. Abarabu baba mu bugaragwa bakomotse kuri Ishimayeli.
name: Kuvuka kwa Isaka

description: Abantu b’ico gihe begeranira mukiyaya kiri hagati y’inzuzi Tigre na Eufurata. Ngo bagomba kwironkera izina rya rurangiranwa mw’isi. Kandi ngo bubake baja hejuru begereza iyo Imana iri. Imana irabasanzaza bakwira ibice vyinshi vyo mw’isi kandi ntibaba bakivuga ururimi rumwe. Uruvyaro ruja kuri Yesu rwamutse kuri Tera se wa Aburahamu.
name: Nimurodi atanguza umugambi wo kwubaka umunara wa Babeli

description: Umuryango wa Esau waba I Edomu mu bumanuko bushira uburengero bw’ikiyaga c’umunyu. Turabona amamuko y’Abamaleki: Elifazi mwene Esau yavyaye Amalekiku ncoreke yiwe Timuna. Abakuru b’imiryango ya bene Esau ni bene Elifazi : Omari, Sefo, Keni na Temani.n’abandi. Turabonamwo abagiye baba abakuru muri uwo muryango. Ibice vyose bikurikira bivuga kuri Yozefu, uwabaye umwizigirwa rurangiranwa.
name: Ubwibone bwaranze umuryango wa Esau

description: Ingeso z’abantu zarononekaye, bakora ivyaha vy’ubuyobe, Imana ifata ingingo yo kubaranduza umwuzure. Kuko Imana yagize iti singomba kuguma nyinyurana n’umuntu w’inuama n’amaraso Ariko Nowa we arakira kuko Imana yari yaramushimye.
name: Uko ingeso z’abantu zononekaye,umwuzure ugatera

description: Yaka abiwe bose ibigirwamana bambaye n’ivyo bafise vyose abihamba mu kuzimu. Asubira I Beteli yubakirayo Imana ibicaniro, kandi ni Imana yamubwiye ngoSubir I Beteli. Uyu musi ushobora kuba warasubiye inyuma mu vyo kumenya mana, ariko iravuga iti garuka ku Mana.
name: Uko Yakobo yimutse ava I Shekemu

description: Isaka yavyaye Yakobo na Esau bari amahasa Uhoraho abwira Rebeka ati mu nda yawe hariyo amahanga abiri, azorushanya inkomezi, kandi Bukuru azokorera Butoyi. Maze avyara Esau aza ari Bukuru, na Yakobo ari we Butoyi. Bamaze kuvuka ntibumvikana, kandi ntibakunda bimwe. Esau yahavuye agurisha ivyo kuba samuragwa kwiwe bica bitahira Yakobo.
name: Ukuvuka kwa Yakobo na Esau

description: Inzoka yahenze umuntu akora ivyo Imana yamubujije. Adamu amaze kunanirwa no kwumvira Imana ubucuti bwiwe na yo buca burononekara, aba atandukanye n’Imana.
name: Umubano mwiza ni umugambi w’Imana

description: Yakobo ageze I Beteli araraho yiseguyr ibuye. Arota icuririzo gishika mw’ijuru, kigereranywa na Krist. Bukeye aca ahagarika rya buye arisukoko amavuta asengera aho nyene Imana irahamwiyerekera.
name: Urugendo rwa Yakobo aja kwa Labani

description: Nowa aranywa araborerwa, aryama atipfutse, Hamu aramumaramaza Nowa na we aca ahezagira Yafeti na Shemu. Ariko mu ruvyaro rwa Hamu hashirwa umuvumo. Abo bahungu ba Nowa batatu bahavuye barondoka bavyara amahanga yose yo mw’isi.
name: Uruvyaro rwa Nowa

description: Yakobo yari ku musego arwaye cane, Yosefu aza kumusuhuza azananye n’abana biwe 2. Akobo arabahezagira mbere yatura yuko abo buzukuru biwe babaye abana biwe bazoharurwa mu bamukwako n’imiryango 12 ya Isirayeli.
name: Yakobo ahezagira abana ba Yozefu

description: Esau yakiriye neza Yakobo aramusanganira aramubwira ati kukubona bisa n’ukubona Imana. Esau yisubirira I Seyiri mu bumanuko bwa Kanani muri Edomu, Yakobo na we aca aja I Sukoti yiyubakirayo inzu. Hagati y’abo bavukanyi babiri habaye gushira hanwe kwiza. Aca agenda I Shekemu acumbikaho yubakiraho Imana igicaniro.
name: Yakobo ahura na Esau

description: Yakobo abaza Imana aca aca aragenda n’umuryangwiwe wose. Bose hamwe bari 66. Baragenda batumbera I Gosheni, Yosefu afata umukogote wiwe aja gusanganir se. Babonanye baragumbirana barizwa n’umunezero umwanya munini. Yosefu aca amenyesha Farawo yuko umuryango wiwe washitse I Gosheni, kandi ari abantu b’abanyenka.
name: Yakobo aja muri Egiputa n’umuryango wiwe wose

description: Ageze kwa Labani AgomwaRakeli umukobwa wa Labani, amukorera imyaka 7 baramubesha bamuha Leya,Yakobo arababara mugabo yemera gukora iyindi myaka ndwi kugira ngo aze ahabwe Rakeli.
name: Yakobo akunda rakeli amukorera imyaka 7 ariko ahabwa Leya

description: Yakobo ahamagaza abana biwe bose ngo ababwire ibizobabako. Aca abwira umwe wese ibizomubako, biba nk’ubuhanuzu buzoba ku muryango umw’umwe wose. Bica biba nk’ubuhanuzi. Bimwe vyaramaze gushika, ibindi biracitezwe
name: Yakobo asezera abahungu biwe imbere yo gupfa

description: Yakobo amaze iyindi myaka 7 bamuha uwo Leya, aca arushiriza kunezerwa, maze abarongora bose uko ari babiri. Rakeli aba ingumba kandi ari we nkundwakazi arababara, hanyuma Imana imuha abana. Yakobo yongera kuguma kwa Labani iyindi myaka 20 kugirango Labani ahebe amureke atahe. arataha n’abagore n’abana biwe. Uhoraho abarira Yakobo ngo asubire mu gihugu ca ba sekuru.
name: Yakobo ashingirwa Rakeli amaze imyaka 14

description: Yakobo ari mu gushika mu gihugu c’amavukiro, abanza gutuma kuri Esau ngo amugirire ikigongwe. Yakobo aho araye ahahurira n’umumarayika baranigana Yakobo araneshwa amenya ko ari Imana yamugendeye. Ati sinkurekura utampezagiye. Umumarayika ati witwa nde? Ati ndi Yakobo, risobanurwa ngo umubeshi. Uno mumarayika ati kuva uyu mwanya uzokwitwa Isirayeli.
name: Yakobo atahuka akitegurira guhura na Esau

description: Yakobo ageze I Beteli Imana yongera kumusezeranira ko izomuha igihugu c’I Kanani, nk’uko yariyagisezeraniye Aburahamu na Isaka. Yakobo aca ashinga igicaniro aho avuganiye n’Imana . Bamubikira ko nyina wiwe Rebeka yapfuye arababara cane, kuko kuva Yakobo ahunga ntiyigeze asubira kubonana na nyina. Mu nyuma umugore wiwe Rakeli avyara Benyamini amusiga ku ngoyi kuko yaciye apfa. Yapfuye assize babiri ari bo Yozefu na Benyamini. Mu nyuma se Isaka arapfa, Yakobo na Esau bakoranywa no kumuhamba.
name: Yakobo atera aja I Beteli

description: Yakobo abonye ukuntu Labani atakimuraba neza ashira abiwe bose ku ngamya baragenda Labani atabizi, Rakeli yagiye yivye ibigirwamana vya se. Labani aboma inyuma abahamvya inyuma y’imisi ndwi. Aho hantu batahatonganira, na Yakobo araserura ivyamubabaje mu myaka 20 yamazei we. Hanyuma barasabana imbabazi, Yakobo abandanya urugendo. Nawe witegura gutunganya ibitagenda neza muri bagenzi bawe kandi wihatire gukora ivyo kugororoka
name: Yakobo ava kwa Labani

description: Isaka yahamagaye Esau, ati genda uhige inyamaswa unzanire akanyama nfungure hanyuma nguhezagire. Ivyo Isaka yavuze, Rebeka aravyuma aca afasha Yakobo kubesha azana amasuguru abiri arayabaga ategurira se Isaya inyama aramuhenda aramuhezagira. Esau agaruka asanga Yakobo yamaze kumwiba umugisha.
name: Yakobo yihindura agatwara umugisha wa Esau

description: Yesu amaze kunesha amageragezwa, aca aja I Kaperinawumu atangura kwigisha. Na we nyene yavuga ati ni mwihane kuko ubwami bwo mw’ijuru buri hafi. Yaciye atangura guhamagara abigishwa biwe ba mbere, hanyuma agenda yigisha mu bisagara vy’I Galilaya akiza abarwaye.
name: Yesu atsinda amageragezwa hanyuma agenda yigisha akora ibitangaza

description: Yosfu ajana se na bakuruwe kwa Farawo ngo ababone, Farawo ati igihugu ngico bereke ahantu heza bahagerere. Baca bagerera harya nyene bashikiye kandi ni ho hari heza cane. Yakobo amaze imyaka 17 muri Egiputa arapfa, asiga asavye Yozefu ngo azomuhambe I Kanani.
name: Yosefu ajana se kwa Farawo

description: Yosefu ataramura abari mu nzu bose asigarana na bene se. Arababwira ati ni jewe Yosefu mwene so mwagurishije. Ac arabarungika n’amahoro, ngo bagende bazane na se bagaruke bose babe ahantu heza muri Gosheni.
name: Yosefu yibwira bene se.

description: Abanyarugo ba Farawo barimw’ibohero barota inzozi zibatera amadidane akomeye. Yosefu arazibarortrera, kandi uko abivuze biba uko nyene.
name: Yozefu saobanura inzizi z’abanyarugo ba Farawo

description: Muka Potifare abona ingene uwo muhungu w’umukozi wiwe ari mwiza aramwipfuza amusaba ko bokorana icaha, Yozefu na we aranka. Ati noshobora nte gukora icaha kingana girtyo ngacumura ku Mana? Umusi umwe uwo mugore asumira wa muhungu, na we aramwifyitura aca asigarana impuzu ya Yozefu. Aramudendereza kugeza aho bamuta mw’ibohero. Yozefu ni we yasobanuye indoto z’abantu babiri bari kumwe mw’ibohero bica bigendauko nyene
name: Yozefu yanka gukorana icana n’umugore waPotifare.

description: Basohokana Tamari ngo bamwice aca arabitanga ati nyen’ibi bintu ni we yanteye inda. Basanga ni Yuda sebukwe yayimuteye, Yuda aramaramara ariko aravyemera. Baca bamuha umuhungu wa Yuda aramurongora.
name: Yuda amaramazwa n’uko ari we yateye inda umukazana wiwe

description: Arabatekerera ivyo kurya ariko ashiraho umutego utuma amakosa agwa kuri Benyemini kugira ngo afatwe mpiri asigare mu buja. Intumbero kwari ukugira ngo nyabuna bose bagaruke abibwire.Ariko Yuda ataramenya ico Yosefu atumbereye, aravuga ati pfuma mugumya jewe ariko Benyamini ntasigare ino. Ico ni ikimenyetso c’ukuntu Yesu yemeye kuducungura ngo twebwe dukire urupfu.
name: Yuda asaba ko yobohwa mu gishingo ca Benyamini.

description: Yakobo bamuhenda ko igikoko cariye Yozefu, agira intuntu idasanzwe. N’aho wobura abawe uremeshwe n’uko bapfuye bizeye Imana, kuko umusi umwe muzosubira kubonana ubutakivana. Yozefu ageze muri Egiputa Imana yakomeje kubana na we. Turabona inkuru y’ivyaha n’ukumaramazwa kwa Yuda.Arongora umunyakananikazi amuvyarako umwana amwita Orunani. Tamari umukazana wa Yuda, agerageza Yuda yigira umumaraya, Yuda aryamana na we. Babwiye Yuda ko Tamari yasambanye none afise inda, Yuda ati ni bamuturire
name: Yuda asambanya umukazana wiwe Tamari
